snippet.title: GIRLS' FRONTLINE 2: EXILIUM | Aphelion Preview Video
snippet.description:
Time-Limited Event [Aphelion] will be open from 3/20.
During the event, Commanders can receive generous rewards including [Collapse Pieces], [Targeted Access Permissions], [Basic Info Cores] by clearing event stages and participating in the Event Game Modes.

[Duration] 
2025/3/20 09:00 ~ 2025/4/30 18:59 (GMT+0)
The event shop exchange will expire at 2025/5/7 18:59 (GMT+0)

[Unlock Conditions] 
Commander Level 20
